conventions.three: metres; +x east, +y up, -z north (the player walks towards -z); right-handed
conventions.ue: centimetres; UE = (x, z, y) * 100 i.e. X = east, Y = south, Z = up. quat = (-qx, -qz, -qy, qw). Assumes the UE glTF importer maps glTF (x, y, z) to UE (x, z, y); check with axis_marker.glb before trusting it.
conventions.kit: unit meshes in kit/*.glb, pivot at the centre of the base; scale = size in metres [x, y, z] in three.js terms
conventions.states: neutral (no mask), don, anna, servant, plus act-specific: hidden, open. visible 0..1 (0 = hidden; silhouettes fade by opacity, solids by scale)

act2.note: Prisms carry three painted faces each (child planes); during the opening they orbit the centre once (12.5 s) and spin three turns.
